cohort: The study included all singleton births greater than 22 weeks' gestation in Dane County, Wisconsin, from January 2016 through June 2018.
finding: The study found an association between birth weight z-score and spatial location, with lowest scores in urban Madison and highest in rural areas, but no association with the Area Deprivation Index.
birth_weight: Birth weight z-scores were measured as the primary outcome for all included infants.
